S&P Global Ratings has revised its outlook on TPG Telecom from negative to stable while affirming the Australian operator's BBB long-term credit rating. The ratings agency said TPG's mobile business was expected to drive earnings and cash-flow growth over the next two years, following changes to its operating model and network arrangements.
